# Batch B018 (part 2) — skills: verify; .editorconfig

@@ output/template/.claude/skills/verify/SKILL.md ;; Workflow skill routed from CLAUDE.md and development-workflow before declaring completion.

56-58 NN ;; dotnet test example.
60-63 MX [wf005.run-relevant-tests,x.vf-test-breadth] ;; Running the package.json-configured frontend tests is WF-005; full suite for small solutions and affected-first for large is an added breadth rule.
65-66 OL [wf005.investigate-failures]

C wf003.scope-risk-evidence OL WF-003,WF-007,WF-021 MUST ;; Produce evidence the change is complete without obvious regressions; match verification to scope and risk; do not require optional tooling the repository has not configured. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf004.inspect-change OL WF-004,TST-010,SEC-001 MUST ;; Review the final changed-file set/diff before choosing checks: scope matches, no unrelated refactoring, no accidental generated/build artifacts, no secrets, probes removed only after step 4 preserved their behaviour. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf004.affected-areas OL WF-004,WF-007 MUST ;; Determine affected areas and choose checks (backend-only → .NET projects; frontend-only → Angular; contract/full-stack → both; docs-only → no unrelated builds). ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf005.build-affected OL WF-005 MUST ;; Build the affected solution/projects and run the frontend's configured build for Angular changes; a build failure means the implementation is not complete. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.vf-no-restore-caution EX WF-005 MUST_NOT ;; Do not use --no-restore unless restore is known to be complete. ;; = ;; Restore known complete. ;; Build-flag caution not in the oracle.
C wf005.run-relevant-tests OL WF-005 MUST ;; Run tests covering the changed area; for Angular use the test command configured in package.json rather than assuming a runner. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.vf-test-breadth EX WF-005,WF-007 DEFAULT ;; For small solutions run the complete test suite; for large solutions run affected projects first, then broader suites as risk requires. ;; = ;; none ;; Test-breadth policy not stated in WF-005.
C wf005.investigate-failures OL WF-005,WF-008 MUST ;; Investigate every newly failing relevant test; do not dismiss failures as unrelated without checking. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf006.runtime-smoke OL WF-006 DEFAULT ;; For new runnable apps or substantial composition/startup/configuration/persistence/full-stack changes verify Development startup (API reachable, Swagger UI loads, configuration binds, DB connectivity/initialization, frontend starts, API base URL/CORS compatible); a build alone does not prove runtime composition. ;; = ;; As applicable. ;;
C tst010.preserve-probes OL TST-010 MUST ;; Represent behaviour uniquely demonstrated by ad-hoc probes in maintained automated tests before completion unless equivalent coverage exists (confirmed); builds, analyzers and existing test runs do not require new tests. ;; = ;; Equivalent coverage exists. ;;
C wf007.risk-scoped OL WF-007 MUST ;; Run architecture, formatting/analyzer, dependency and security checks when relevant, not indiscriminately. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf007.architecture-check OL WF-007,WF-001,ARC-001 MUST ;; When boundaries are touched read architecture.md (and persistence.md) and check references, flow, repositories, EF boundary, UoW and direction; run check-manifests from the repository root when project files changed. ;; = ;; none ;;
C pst008.verify-seeder OL PST-008 MUST ;; When Domain/persistence changes affect the seed graph confirm DbSeeder remains valid and representative for a fresh Development database. ;; = ;; Skip for docs-only/unrelated changes. ;;
C wf007.configured-format OL WF-007 MUST ;; Run configured formatting/analyzers when the repository configures them. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov013.no-new-analyzers OL GOV-013,DEP-001,WF-021 MUST_NOT ;; Do not add a formatter/analyzer dependency solely to complete verification; treat analyzer output as evidence needing context. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf007.dependency-security OL WF-007,DEP-004 MUST ;; For dependency or security-sensitive changes inspect package vulnerabilities and changed secrets/authorization/SQL/CORS/TLS/logging/certificate validation; a full security-scan is not needed for every small change. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf004.final-diff OL WF-004,GOV-003,GOV-021,TST-010 MUST ;; Review the final diff after fixes for unrelated edits, commented code, temporary logging, TODO/FIXME, stale temp tests, architecture drift, unapproved spec/settings drift, stale artefacts after settings changes and unpreserved manual verification. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run010.clean-usings OL RUN-010 MUST ;; Before completion remove unused/redundant usings (incl. those provided by implicit/global usings unless needed for clarity) from every C# file created or modified, without repository-wide cleanup, verifying the changed files. ;; = ;; Explicit import needed for clarity/disambiguation. ;;
C wf008.fix-retry OL WF-008 MUST ;; On failure identify it, apply the smallest fix, rerun affected verification (and build/tests when code changed), repeat until green or genuine user input is required. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf008.no-hidden-failure OL WF-008,WF-009,WF-013 MUST_NOT ;; Never hide a known failure and declare completion; failures needing diagnosis go through build-fix. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf009.report-actual OL WF-009 MUST ;; Report what was actually run, using NOT RUN or NOT APPLICABLE instead of implying unchecked areas passed. ;; = ;; none ;;

C x.ec-whitespace EX RUN-009 ENFORCED_DEFAULT ;; All files use UTF-8, space indentation, a final newline and trimmed trailing whitespace (Markdown keeps trailing whitespace). ;; = ;; Markdown exempt from trailing-whitespace trimming. ;; RUN-009 requires following .editorconfig but does not fix its content; these concrete formatting settings are candidate-specific.
C x.ec-indent EX RUN-009 ENFORCED_DEFAULT ;; Indent 2 spaces for JSON/YAML, project/XML files and TS/JS/HTML/SCSS/CSS (TS/JS single quotes); 4 spaces for C#. ;; = ;; none ;; Concrete indentation/quote settings are candidate-specific (RUN-009 only defers to .editorconfig).
C x.ec-usings-order EX RUN-010 ENFORCED_DEFAULT ;; System usings sorted first; using directives placed outside the namespace (suggestion). ;; = ;; none ;; Using-ordering/placement conventions not in the oracle.
C run010.ide0005 OL RUN-010 ENFORCED ;; Unused/redundant usings (IDE0005) are reported at warning severity. ;; = ;; Command-line build reporting additionally requires GenerateDocumentationFile. ;;
C run024.file-scoped-suggestion OL RUN-024 ENFORCED_ADVISORY ;; File-scoped namespace declarations are suggested. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.ec-no-qualification EX RUN-009 ENFORCED_ADVISORY ;; Do not qualify fields, properties, methods or events with this. (suggestion). ;; = ;; none ;; Qualification style not in the oracle.
C run024.async-suffix-suggestion OL RUN-024 ENFORCED_ADVISORY ;; async methods are suggested to end with Async. ;; = ;; Framework/interface contracts may differ. ;;
